market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a tug-of-war: strong jobs data and Fed-hike bets pressure equities and gold, while oil spikes and AI momentum support energy and tech. Dow's +600-pt day shows resilience, but S&P 500 flat week signals caution. Next CPI print is the critical catalyst. Expect volatility in rates, oil, and FX. Mortgage rates at 1-year high will weigh on housing and consumer sentiment into Q4.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle (Nvidia-Hugging Face, GPT-6, Microsoft) supports multi-year tech earnings growth. Geopolitical oil premium likely persists through 2027 given Iran/Ukraine. US tariff regime reshapes manufacturing and defense supply chains structurally. Sovereign gold diversification and potential US Treasury outflows suggest gradual dollar devaluation trend. EM currencies may stabilize post-streak cap. Housing affordability remains a 12-month structural concern.
